# Codependence

> Codependence is a CLI-first dependency version policy tool. It checks, reports, and updates dependency versions across Node, Python, Go, Rust, Docker, GitHub Actions, and Helm from one root `.codependencerc`, locally, in CI, or as a GitHub Action.

Install as a root devDependency (`npm install codependence --save-dev`) and run `codependence` to check targets or `codependence --update` to apply policy. `codependence init actions` generates split scheduled workflows per manager area, each maintaining a stable pull-request branch such as `update-dependencies/docker`.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/introduction): Enforce dependency version policy locally, in CI, and across workspaces
- [Main Use Case](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/main-usecase): Keep important versions intentional with per-manager targets

## Usage

- [CLI](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/cli): Commands, flags, and `.codependencerc` configuration
- [GitHub Action](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/github-action): Create small dependency update pull requests by manager
- [Node.js](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/node): Use Codependence as a Node.js module for custom policy checks
- [Options](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/options): Configuration options for targets, managers, and execution
- [Usage Examples](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/usage): Standalone CLI, npm scripts, CI, and Node utility patterns

## Advanced

- [Policy Surface](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/policy-surface): What Codependence checks today and where policy can expand next
- [Recipes](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/recipes): Common patterns and usage examples
